commands.description: Action: open or close the About window, as Help > About and its close button do. Read windows.about in the returned editor state. Repeated values are harmless. Retained across document replacement, layout reset and listener restart; closed on process restart. Editor only, all document formats. No document, history or settings write; no ACP host approval is needed.

Action: open, copy or close the editor's existing address dialog. Open requires target: configuration, online_documentation, soul2d_live_documentation, bug_report or feature_request. Configuration uses the settings path's parent and refuses when unavailable. No browser, folder or external app is launched. Copy and close forbid target, including null. Copy requires an open dialog and queues its original address through egui's clipboard output; the reply does not confirm OS clipboard delivery. Close is idempotent. Read windows.addressDialog: null or {target,title,address}. Retained across document replacement and layout reset, closed on process restart. Editor only, all document formats. No document, history or settings write. Manifest effect clipboard-write applies to copy; open and close only change window state.
Action: arm a parameter in the editor so its keypoint is edited, or disarm with null. The parameter value is not moved; the key is the keypoint closest to it. Editor only. Not a document edit.
Action: frame the given nodes in the editor viewport, or the whole model when nodes is left out. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: move the editor viewport. centre is the world point in the middle of the view; zoom is in points per world unit and must be within the editor's zoom limits. mirror sets Mirror View. Give at least one; omitted fields stay unchanged. Session only. Editor only. Not a document edit.
Action: give every view the active view's centre and zoom (Same display position). INX and CMO3 documents only. Mirror View stays global. Session only. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: open or close the Command Browser, as Edit > Command Browser, its shortcut, close button and Escape do. Read windows.commandBrowser in the returned editor state. Repeated open preserves the current search, selection, argument draft and result; closing clears them. Retained across document replacement, layout reset and listener restart; closed on process restart. Editor only, all document formats. No document, history or settings write; no ACP host approval is needed.

Action: show or hide the canvas grid of the editor viewport and set its spacing in world units (1 to 1000000) and its colour as unmultiplied [r, g, b, a]. The lines run through the world origin and are not drawn when they would be closer than 4 points. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: set the guide lines of the editor viewport (Cubism Guide Line). open shows or closes the Guide Settings window, independently of show. lines replaces every guide: each is {axis: horizontal | vertical, position in world units, colour?: unmultiplied [r, g, b, a], memo?}; a guide without a colour gets the default colour, which colour sets. show draws them; snap makes vertices moved with the Point tool adhere to a guide within 8 points. At most 256 guides and 256 characters of memo. Editor only. Not a document edit.
guiEntry: Viewport context menu > Guide line > Guide Settings

commands.description: Action: reset the editor layout like View > Reset Layout. Show panels whose visibility was stored, forget Outline and Timeline sizes and floating window positions. Never-written visibility keys stay absent. Open windows, collapsed state, saved workspaces, drafts and document history stay unchanged. Returns editor state. Saves existing visibility settings when the editor has a settings file; a failed write reports a session-only reset. ACP calls wait for host file-write approval on the original HTTP call; do not retry while waiting. Editor only.

Action: set the CMO3/CAN3 native parameter panel's case-insensitive name-or-ID substring filter. Empty clears it. Available without an attached model (no rows). Returns nativeParameterPanel in editor state. Retained across document replacement, reset on restart. Editor only. No document, settings, parameter value or playback change.
guiEntry: Outline > Live2D native preview > Model parameters / facial controls > Native parameter filter

commands.description: Action: turn Onion Slice and Trajectories of the editor viewport on or off. With a frame of an animation previewed (animation_seek), Onion Slice draws the frames around it faintly (animation_onion) and Trajectories draws the paths the selected Part's vertices take (animation_trajectory). INX documents. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: show or hide one editor panel, outline or timeline, through the same operation as View > Panels. The other panel, panel sizes, drafts and document history stay unchanged. Returns editor state. Saves the setting when the editor has a settings file; a failed write reports that the change holds only for this session. ACP calls that save settings wait for host Allow/Deny on the original HTTP call, for at most two minutes; do not retry while waiting. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: set the INX Parameters panel's name filter, selected animation, or transient parameter bookmark. An empty filter clears it; bookmark null shows all parameters. labelIndex selects a stored label of the selected animation, or part and model-space point resolve the Part's related parameters. Omitted fields stay unchanged; changing animation pauses playback, resets the local seek frame and clears the old bookmark. Give at least one field. Returns parameterPanel in editor state. Editor only. No document or settings write.
guiEntry: Outline > INX animation controls > clip combo

commands.description: Action: enable or disable the editor's live physics preview. Enabling requires an INX document; disabling is allowed for every document format. The window keeps the flag across document replacement; physics runs only for INX. A failed step or successful physics bake turns it off. Session only. Editor only. Not a document edit or a settings write.

Action: turn Lightweight playback of the editor on or off (Cubism Lightweight playback) and the timeline's lock of playback to the animation framerate, either or both. With lightweight on, while the window's Play runs an animation, a CAN3 scene or a Motion3 clip, the parameter panels keep the values they showed before it started. With snapToFramerate on, the window's Play moves an INX animation in whole frames of its timestep and starts from the whole frame below a fractional one. Playback driven over MCP (animation_advance, motion3_advance) is not the window's and is unaffected. Session only. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: Request a non-discarding editor exit after this identified reply is locally flushed and a final safety check passes. Refuses unsaved changes, unapplied drafts, active tools/work and pending dialogs. Acceptance is conditional: new work or failed delivery cancels exit. No Save/Discard decisions. ACP requires exact human lifecycle approval, the initiating uncancelled end_turn and release of its owned client before the fresh final check. Headless, notifications and internal calls refuse.

Action: dismiss this window's startup recovery offer, as Keep for later does. Recovery files remain on disk and are offered again at the next startup. Repeating this call succeeds. A temporarily hidden offer may also be dismissed; this does not answer a waiting dialog, change the document or its drafts, or write settings. Returns editor state. Editor only.
Read: the crash-recovery snapshots that earlier sessions left for unsaved documents, newest first, as the editor offers them at startup. Each id is the snapshot's file name. Editor only.

Action: open the recovery snapshot with this id (from editor_recovery_list) as an untitled, modified document, as the Restore button does. Refused like open while a draft is open or the document has unsaved changes, and while a dialog in the editor waits for the user's answer. Editor only.

Action: select in the editor. nodes: these nodes, in this order (the first is the primary); an empty list clears the node selection. bindings: these {node, channel} bindings of the armed parameter at its key (the Parameters panel's binding rows). vertices: these indices of the active mesh edit's points (with nodes, the first node must be the edit's node). Give at least one; omitted fields stay as they are. A refused call changes nothing. Editor only: a host without a window refuses it. Not a document edit.
Read: listed editor preferences (Settings controls and View > Stats for Nerds) with their current values, types and allowed values or ranges, plus the shortcut bindings. Editor only.

Action: change one setting that editor_settings_get lists with writable true, validated, applied and saved through the shared preference setter. NerdStats is the Stats for Nerds window's visibility boolean, off by default. An ACP request that saves settings waits for explicit host approval of the original call (up to two minutes); do not retry while it waits. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: bind one editor command to a keyboard shortcut, or unbind it with null, as the Settings window's Shortcuts pane does; the settings file is saved. command is a command id from the shortcuts list of editor_settings_get; shortcut is that list's spec form: Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Super and one key (A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, Left, Right, Up, Down) joined by +, for example Ctrl+Shift+S. A chord another command held moves to this one and the result names the displaced command. repeat (default: the command's current flag) lets a held key repeat the command. An ACP request waits for host approval like editor_settings_set. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: turn the Solo view of the editor viewport on or off (Cubism Solo) and set its inactive colour as unmultiplied [r, g, b, a], whose alpha is its opacity. With Solo on, the selected nodes of an INX document are drawn in front and the rest under the inactive colour. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: open or close Texture Viewer, as Tools > Texture Viewer and its close button do. Read windows.textureViewer in the returned editor state. Repeated open preserves Slot, Zoom, loaded images, loading and errors; close drops the viewer and reopening starts unloaded at Slot 0, Zoom 1. Uses the existing selected-Part texture_get loading path. Retained across document replacement, layout reset and listener restart; closed on process restart. Editor only, all document formats. No document, history or settings write; no ACP host approval is needed.

Action: set the Timeline's absolute display multiplier through the same stored value as its Zoom out, slider, Zoom in and hover zoom gesture. Requires a finite number; rounds to the window's f32 and clamps to 0.5 through 10. Returns editor state with timeline.zoom reporting the stored value. Retained across animations, document replacement and layout changes, including while Timeline is hidden, no animation is selected or the document is not INX. A fresh editor starts at 1. Does not seek, pause, edit the document or save settings. Editor only.
Action: switch the tool of the editor's current edit mode to one of tool.offered in resource://soul2d/editor/state. Editor only. Not a document edit.

Action: set the editor viewport's selection overlays (vertices, bounds and orientation gizmo) and opaque RGB background [r, g, b], each an integer from 0 to 255. [0, 0, 0] resets the background to black. Give at least one; omitted fields stay unchanged. The overlays depend on the selection and edit mode. partSort (INX only) orders Part menu candidates front-to-back (z_sort) or by ascending bounding-box area (size_sort); it does not change direct hit testing. Sort updates outside INX refuse the entire patch. Retained across document replacement, reset on restart. Session only. Editor only. Not a document edit or a settings write.
guiEntry: INX viewport context menu > Z-Sort / Size-Sort

commands.description: Action: open or close the Welcome window, as Help > Welcome does. Opening shows Quick Setup until the quick setup is done and the start page after it; an open window keeps its page. Read windows.welcome in the returned editor state. Repeated values are harmless; closing does not mark the quick setup done. The editor opens the window at start until the quick setup is done. Retained across document replacement, layout reset and listener restart. Its choices are editor_settings_set (DarkMode, lang, UIScale), new, open and import_psd. Editor only, all document formats. No document, history or settings write; no ACP host approval is needed.
Action: restore a saved workspace: show or hide the Outline and Timeline panels and give them the saved sizes. Floating windows keep their places. Editor only. Not a document edit.
Action: delete a saved workspace. Editor only. Not a document edit.
guiEntry: View > Workspace > Delete Workspace > saved name

commands.description: Action: save the editor layout as a named workspace (Cubism Workspace): whether the Outline and Timeline panels are shown, and their sizes. A name that exists is replaced. At most 16 workspaces; names are trimmed, 1 to 64 characters without control characters. Kept in the editor settings. Editor only. Not a document edit.
Evaluate a model at runtime parameter values.
Return the current INP container bytes.

Copy the open INX document into the folder dir, with every image its DepthDraw layers and animation sequences name copied to dir/assets and named there by a relative path, so the folder can move as one. The file is named after the open document (model.inx when it has no file); the open document and its links are unchanged. A source that is missing refuses the whole copy; existing files are only replaced with overwrite.

Render the animation of the open INP/INX document as numbered stills: path must end in .png or .tga and frame N is written to <stem>-N.<ext> beside it. Runs to completion before replying; returns the frame count and the first and last file. An existing file is only replaced with overwrite. Limited to 1000000000 pixels in total (frames x width x height); use export_video_start with an image codec beyond that.The clip's image tracks (animation_image_add) are drawn with the model; imagesLeftOut in the reply names the ones that cannot be drawn.

Render the animation of the open INP/INX document as one animated GIF: path gets the .gif extension. colors (2 to 256, default 256) is the palette of each frame; with transparency one slot of it is the transparent colour. No dithering. repeat (0 to 65535) is how many times the clip plays again after the first time, absent loops forever and 0 plays once. A GIF shows a frame for whole hundredths of a second, at least 2 (browsers slow shorter frames down): the rate is rounded (the reply's delay), and a clip faster than 50 fps is rendered at 50 fps, so it keeps its length. Runs to completion before replying; an existing file is only replaced with overwrite. Limited to 1000000000 pixels in total (frames x width x height). The clip's image tracks (animation_image_add) are drawn with the model; imagesLeftOut in the reply names the ones that cannot be drawn.

Export the open INX document as layered planes in glTF 2.0 without changing the session: one mesh for each drawn Part at its rest shape, placed along Z in draw order, with its texture as an embedded PNG. DepthBones become nodes and each key of a one-axis parameter becomes a morph target. `path` ends in .glb (binary) or .gltf (one file, buffer inside). unitsPerMetre is the number of canvas units for one metre of the file and is required. Bone weights, masks, blend modes, composites, physics, animations and two-axis parameters are listed in the returned loss report as dropped, so the call needs lossy=true. Rights data an import kept is written to `asset.extras` and shown under `rights` (`truncated` names `rights` when that view is not all of it), and the call then needs acknowledgeRights=true, which only the user may decide. While `needs` names an argument, or with dryRun=true, the report is returned and nothing is written (`applied` false). An existing file is only replaced with overwrite. The last applied report is readable at resource://soul2d/export/gltf-report.

Render one camera of the open INP/INX document to an image file without changing the session. The extension is forced to the format's (png, tga or jpeg). An existing file is only replaced with overwrite. Not available for native Live2D documents (use render).
Export the open INX document as an INP runtime file (atlas packing, pruning) without changing the session. The .inp extension is forced; an existing file is only replaced with overwrite.
guiEntry: File > Import > Export > Export soul2d_live puppet...

commands.description: Ask a running video export to stop. ffmpeg is closed and the partial file is kept; export_video_status reports cancelled once it has stopped.

Plan the actual host-configured ffmpeg command for an INP/INX video export without running a process, rendering or writing output. Accepts the same options as export_video_start, including preset/audio; respects overwrite and host extra options. Requires a valid output parent and protects the open document. Refuses Motion3 preview, but permits an existing video job. Returns program, argument vector, working directory, output and timing plus omission warnings. Caches the last successful preview as the video-command resource; new/open clears it. This is a preview, not executable-resolution or later-launch proof.

Start one background codec probe using the host-configured encoder and fixed -codecs arguments. No file or document edits. Refuses another running probe. Uses the existing five-second timeout and bounded output; poll export_video_probe_status or the video-codecs resource. Requests cannot choose a program or extra options.
Read the last codec probe: idle, running, finished with codecs or failed with error, including the program captured at start. Never waits for a running worker; available for every document format.

Start encoding the animation of the open INP/INX document with ffmpeg (arguments only, no shell) on a background thread and return its job id; poll export_video_status. One encode runs at a time. A failed or cancelled encode can leave a partial output file, and with overwrite an existing file is already replaced when the encode starts. Extra ffmpeg options are a host setting, not a request field. preset (instead of codec) picks the encoder and the extension: mp4 (H.264, no transparency), webm (VP9, with alpha under transparency) or mov (ProRes 4444 with alpha, 422 HQ without). audio names a sound file to mux in with the container's audio codec (AAC in mp4 and mov), padded with silence or cut to the video's length. Without it the clip's unmuted audio tracks (animation_audio_add) are mixed in, each starting where its frame first shows; audioLeftOut in the reply names the tracks that cannot play. The clip's image tracks (animation_image_add) are drawn with the model; imagesLeftOut in the reply names the ones that cannot be drawn.
Read a video export job: state running, finished, failed (with error) or cancelled, and the frames done of the total. Does not wait.
Read one named payload of the INX extension section as base64.
Store (base64 string) or remove (base64 null) one named payload of the INX extension section as one undo step.
Forget every retained undo state except the current one without changing the document.
Restore a retained undo state by index when the expected revision matches.
Set how many undo states the history retains (2 to 1000, default 100). Shrinking drops the oldest states, never the current one; the document is untouched.
Read retained undo history position, capacity and state flags without changing the session.
Inspect an 8-bit image or run the RGBA color-bleed padding transform without changing the session.
Import the PNG/TGA files of a folder as one Part each into a new unsaved project.
Open an INP/INX file as a new unsaved project (no project path).

Replace the session with a new model built from a Krita (.kra) file. The snapshot gains imported {nodes, textures}, plus skippedLayers (layers that were not imported), groupBlendNotApplied (groups whose blend mode no node carries) and blendModesNotApplied (blend modes the engine lacks, imported as Normal) when there are any.

Replace the session with a new model built from a layered PSD file. The snapshot gains imported {nodes, textures}, plus blendModesNotApplied (blend modes the engine lacks, imported as Normal) when there are any. A layer clipped to the layer below it gets a Mask binding to that layer (or its group).
Advance the selected CAN3 preview by seconds; looping uses the scene frame duration.

Attach an explicit CAN3 to the active CMO3 for bounded native parameter and GUID-bound PartOpacity playback. Parameter GUID/attribute IDs and Part GUIDs are validated against the selected model resource; underscore PartOpacity channels retain their exact map keys. Linked paths are never followed automatically.

Bind CAN3 parameter and PartOpacity channels of one linked-model resource to one explicit CMO3 without changing the active session. Parameters use exact parameter GUID and live2dParam_ attribute ID. Typed source parameter IDs are reported as matchesId/differentId, legacy s labels as legacyText, and empty source maps as null/missing after exact matching. Part GUIDs supply canonical Part IDs; raw source identity remains metadata. Underscore channels report exact mapKey with scene/track/curveId in underscorePartBindings or unboundUnderscorePartCurves; duplicate attribute IDs do not merge channels. Does not verify stored link provenance, play animation, or establish Cubism equivalence.

Add an empty CAN3 parameter or modern PartOpacity curve in one undo step. Requires matching expectedRevision and a CMO3 modelPath. Give exactly one of parameterId or partId. Parameter curves copy the source GUID and range; they also store the parameter's default as baseValue, and a re-added original keeps the baseValue it stores; new Part curves use the source Part GUID, typed CPartId identity and range [0,1]. Re-adding an original Part curve preserves its source identity and range. Creates an owned parts-visible effect when absent. A new parameter or modern Part curve is saved as a copy of a curve of its kind the file already stores, with the new identity, range, key and fresh xs.idx, the display name another curve of the same target carries, and the file's shared typed ID and GUID objects where it names them by reference; the synthetic layout is used only when the file has no such curve, or the track has no Part effect yet, or the curve it would copy stores no baseValue; in a track or scene added in the same save, such a curve is refused. Duplicate targets and unsupported or shared mutable storage are refused. Native save preserves unrelated XML and CAFF data. Cubism Editor acceptance is not established.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > New CAN3 curve > Parameter > target > Add CAN3 curve
CAN3 Outline > New CAN3 curve > PartOpacity > target > Add CAN3 curve

commands.description: Delete one CAN3 parameter, modern PartOpacity, legacy-colon PartOpacity or underscore-map PartOpacity curve in one undo step. Requires matching expectedRevision. Optional partOpacityMapKey selects an exact underscore map key and is required when curveId is ambiguous; a supplied selector never falls back. Removes the owned map entry, optional mapped member and attribute definition together; modern members remain required. A parameter curve's attribute-map entries go with it, and the shared GUID, id and type objects it names stay. The effect, shared or inline, and its registry remain. Shared, aliased, nested shared or externally referenced removed storage is refused. Other curves, unknown XML outside removed nodes and unrelated CAFF data are preserved. Cubism Editor acceptance is not established.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > scene > track > curve > Delete curve > Confirm curve deletion

commands.description: Set interpolation of the CAN3 parameter, modern PartOpacity or legacy-colon or underscore-map PartOpacity, or supported Guide visual scalar segment starting at an existing key: SMOOTH, BEZIER, LINEAR or STEP, with shared revision, undo/redo and native save. A segment set to smooth or Bezier must have its handles in frame order. The last key starts no segment, but its stored type can be set. Soul2D plays SMOOTH and BEZIER the same way and does not recompute handles. Guide uses the six visualCurves IDs, complete supported ownership and no partOpacityMapKey; Image and Sound types remain unsupported. This edits stored types without proving Guide interpolation or playback equivalence. For underscore-map channels, optional partOpacityMapKey selects the exact raw map key and is required when curveId is ambiguous; a supplied selector never falls back.

Move one Bezier handle of an existing CAN3 parameter, modern PartOpacity or legacy-colon or underscore-map PartOpacity key, or supported Guide visual scalar key: side previous or next, frame (fractional) and value, with shared revision, undo/redo and native save. Give at least one of frame and value. A smooth or Bezier segment the handle shapes must stay in frame order if it was. Save rewrites only the handle's posF and doubleValue; its integer pos and isPosOptimized and every other stored field stay as they are. Guide uses the six visualCurves IDs, complete supported ownership and no partOpacityMapKey; Image and Sound controls remain unsupported. This edits stored controls without proving Guide interpolation or playback equivalence. For underscore-map channels, optional partOpacityMapKey selects the exact raw map key and is required when curveId is ambiguous; a supplied selector never falls back.

Link a static PNG or JPEG to the active CAN3 as a new Image resource. Requires imagePath and matching expectedRevision; returns snapshot plus resourceGuid. Validates bounded complete image data, then stores its canonical path and basename using an existing owned Image resource as donor. The image is not embedded and no track is created. Mixed pending Model and Image resources share one save. Unknown references, ambiguous memberships and unsupported custom names are refused. One undo step; no Cubism Editor acceptance is claimed.

Replace only an existing Image resource's stored link with the canonical path of a validated static PNG or JPEG. All tracks sharing resourceGuid use that link; names, transforms, keys and memberships remain unchanged. Requires an editable stored path and matching expectedRevision. One undo step; a matching path is a no-op. No resizing, rendering or Cubism Editor equivalence is claimed.

Add one CAN3 parameter, modern PartOpacity, legacy-colon or underscore-map PartOpacity, or existing Image or supported Guide visual scalar key in one undo step. expectedRevision must match the current document revision. anchorFrame is an unused signed 32-bit integer and value is finite. Omitted type defaults to LINEAR. Both controls coincide with the anchor, corner is true and positionOptimized is false. Requires supported inline sequence storage, valid extrema caches and valid affected current segments. Shared or referenced keys are refused. Image/Guide channels accept the six raw IDs listed in visualCurves and reject partOpacityMapKey; XY and integer channels are unsupported. Guide requires complete supported track ownership and consistent empty effect maps. Native save preserves unrelated XML and CAFF data. Cubism Editor acceptance is not established. For underscore-map channels, optional partOpacityMapKey selects the exact raw map key and is required when curveId is ambiguous; a supplied selector never falls back.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > scene > track > curve > New key > Add CAN3 key

commands.description: Delete the existing CAN3 parameter, modern PartOpacity, legacy-colon or underscore-map PartOpacity, or Image or supported Guide visual scalar key at anchorFrame in one undo step. expectedRevision must match the current document revision. Its paired curve type is removed. Deleting the final key leaves empty arrays and keeps the original template extrema tokens. Requires supported inline sequence storage, valid extrema caches and valid affected current segments. Shared or referenced keys are refused. Image/Guide channels accept the six raw IDs listed in visualCurves and reject partOpacityMapKey; XY and integer channels are unsupported. Guide requires complete supported track ownership and consistent empty effect maps. Native save preserves unrelated XML and CAFF data. Cubism Editor acceptance is not established. For underscore-map channels, optional partOpacityMapKey selects the exact raw map key and is required when curveId is ambiguous; a supplied selector never falls back.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > scene > track > curve > key > Delete key

commands.description: Edit one existing CAN3 parameter, modern PartOpacity, legacy-colon or underscore-map PartOpacity, or Image/Guide visual scalar anchor value with shared revision, undo/redo and native save. Image/Guide curveId is scalex, scaley, rotate, shear, opacity or artPathWidth, as listed in visualCurves; these channels reject partOpacityMapKey. Guide requires its complete supported track ownership and empty-map layout. Image handles and interpolation-type editing remain unsupported; supported Guide scalar channels also accept handle and type edits. Signed anchorFrame identifies the key; controls, key frames and unknown data stay unchanged. Anchor extrema caches are verified and updated; stored evaluation caches are invalidated. Shared scalar storage is rejected; this raw source edit does not claim Cubism playback equivalence. For underscore-map channels, optional partOpacityMapKey selects the exact raw map key and is required when curveId is ambiguous; a supplied selector never falls back.
List active CAN3 scenes and the explicit native model/resource attachment, if any.

Add one CAN3 Image or supported Guide xy or anchor key with explicit frame, coordinates and corner. Requires increasing existing frames, a new signed-i32 frame and finite f32 coordinates; values round to f32. Uses a verified private inline layout, preserves retained points and base point, and refuses unknown structural metadata for insertion or corner replacement. Recreating an original frame with its original corner reconciles as a coordinate edit or no-op, preserving its original record and unknown metadata. Supports revision checks, Undo/Redo and native save/reopen. Does not establish interpolation or Cubism playback equivalence.

Delete one existing CAN3 Image or supported Guide xy or anchor point. Requires a matching expectedRevision and unique signed anchorFrame. Preserves the channel, base point, retained points and unrelated native bytes; an empty channel remains readable. Supports only verified inline point-array layouts; shared, aliased or unknown structural storage is refused. Uses Undo/Redo and native save/reopen. Does not establish Cubism playback equivalence.

Edit both coordinates of one existing CAN3 Image or supported Guide xy or anchor point, selected by sceneGuid, trackGuid, curveId and signed anchorFrame. x and y must fit finite f32 storage; values round to f32 and equivalent values are no-ops. Updates both stored coordinate copies while preserving frame, corner, base point, other channels and unrelated bytes. Shared or inconsistent storage is refused. Uses expectedRevision, Undo/Redo and native save/reopen; no point insertion, interpolation or Cubism playback claim.

Read CAN3 scenes, model tracks and existing parameter keys without changing the active session. scene.imageTracks separately lists image-track identity, timing, visualCurves and pointChannels for stored xy/anchor coordinates. scene.soundTracks lists existing Sound track guid, name, resourceGuid, start, internalOffset and duration for deletion; it does not decode audio or expose volume. scene.guideTracks lists the same identity and timing fields plus six supported visualCurves and pointChannels for stored xy/anchor coordinates of existing GuideImage tracks; guide directories are never opened. Unsupported or malformed Image/Guide scalar channels are omitted; budget exhaustion fails the read. imageResources lists linked image GUIDs and names/sourceFile paths only where stored; paths are literal and never opened. Values and frames retain stored units; control positions and flags are not evaluated. scene.loop, scene.tag and a parameter curve's baseValue appear only where the file stores them. Does not load linked models, play animation, edit keys, or establish Cubism compatibility.
Clear only the session CAN3 preview values.

Link a CMO3 model to the active CAN3 document as a new resource, the first half of placing a model on the animation canvas; live2d_animation_track_add then places it in a scene. Requires modelPath (a readable CMO3) and matching expectedRevision; the reply is the snapshot with resourceGuid. Save copies the file's own resource entry with a new CResourceGuid, the file name and the absolute model path, and lists it in the resource manager's reference list, GUID map and root group. A file without a resource entry in Cubism's layout is refused. One undo step. Cubism Editor acceptance is not run.

Add an empty scene with a new random GUID at the end of the active CAN3 document's scenes, with shared revision, undo/redo and native save. The reply is the snapshot with sceneGuid. Where the document's last scene shows scene.tag, the new scene takes a copy of it, shown as scene.tag; live2d_animation_scene_set clears it with an empty tag. Save copies the last scene the file stores in Cubism's layout, with its root group, a new CSceneGuid, fresh xs.idx, the new name, frame rate, length and tag, loop off, and the workspace over the whole scene as the copied scene sets it; tracks added to the new scene are copied like added tracks. A file without such a scene gets a scene holding only its GUID, name, frame rate, length, the tag where one is shown, and an empty track list. Cubism Editor 5.3.04 opened a copied scene with an added track, curve and keys on 2026-10-20; it has not opened the minimal scene.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > New CAN3 scene > Add CAN3 scene

commands.description: Delete one owned CAN3 scene and its supported Model, Image, Sound and Guide tracks in one undo step. Model tracks include parameter curves and modern, legacy-colon and underscore-map PartOpacity definitions; Image, Sound and Guide tracks use the same ownership checks as track deletion. Requires sceneGuid and matching expectedRevision. Refuses shared, aliased, externally referenced or unsupported track storage and unowned Part map/list entries. Inline unshared Part inheritance and tracks with parameter controls are supported; nested shared storage is refused. Local FormEdit data uses the same strict shared-keyform ownership checks as track deletion; unsupported form layouts are refused. A scene's shared GUID and the playlist items that name it go with it, and the animation's current scene and the resource manager's scene move to the next kept scene, else the previous. The last scene may be deleted only when no stored scene pointer needs a surviving target. Linked model, image, sound and guide-directory resources and shared identities remain. Guide tracks use the same strict layout checks as track deletion. Unsupported members are refused. Preserves unrelated native data. Cubism vendor acceptance is not run.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > scene > Delete scene > Confirm scene deletion

commands.description: Change the name, frame rate, length in frames, loop setting or tag of one scene in the active CAN3 document, with shared revision, undo/redo and native save. Give at least one of name, fps, durationFrames, loop and tag. loop is the scene's stored isLoopMotion flag, shown as scene.loop only where the scene stores one; elsewhere it is refused. tag is the scene's stored tag text, shown as scene.tag only where the scene stores one; an empty tag clears it, and elsewhere it is refused. It does not change how Soul2D plays the scene. Save rewrites only those elements; settings stored shared or aliased are refused. Tracks and keys are not moved or cut to the new length.

Sample one CAN3 scene at a GUI frame from runtime/default parameter values. Unsupported curve tokens or conflicting writers are errors. Empty PartOpacity channels produce no write; multiple populated channels for one Part are refused, including modern, legacy-colon and underscore-map channels.

Add an empty CAN3 model track to an existing scene using an existing linked-model resource. Requires sceneGuid, resourceGuid, name and matching expectedRevision. Returns a session snapshot plus trackGuid. The track gets a new GUID, starts at frame 0 with offset 0, and uses the scene duration. Save copies a model track the file already stores, preferably from the same scene, with its effects, a new CTrackGuid, fresh xs.idx and empty curve lists, and adds it to the scene's root group; the synthetic layout is used only when the scene has no root group or no such track. Preserves unrelated native data and provides one undo step. Does not add model resources or claim Cubism vendor acceptance.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > New CAN3 track > Add CAN3 track

commands.description: Delete one owned CAN3 Model, Image, supported Sound or supported GuideImage track. Model tracks include owned parameter and modern, legacy-colon and underscore-map PartOpacity definitions; image tracks include their owned VisualDefault attributes. Requires sceneGuid, unique trackGuid and matching expectedRevision. Part maps use exact stored identities; mapped members may be absent or one bare reference. Refuses unowned entries, shared or nested shared storage, referenced map keys and outside references; the effect-kind ids and attribute-map keys Cubism shares across tracks stay, and a null sequence backlink is accepted for older track families. Inline unshared Part inheritance is supported. A track's parameter controls go with it: its ParamCtrlGroups effect and attributes, its marker and point GUIDs, the scene's calculation-order entries naming it, and group heads and drawable identities no other track names. Local FormEdit data with distinct shared keyform and frame definitions is supported when time-remapping links, frame caches and ownership agree; retained form and object identities stay. Empty inline keyforms with private dummy-owned remapping attributes and sparse maps of shared-root attributes are supported; their lists, caches, identities and exclusive references must agree. Foreign parameter-group frame-step attributes remain unchanged and must not reference deleted storage; same-owner attributes use ordinary ownership checks. Global form maps and nonempty inline keyforms are refused. Preserves unrelated XML and linked resources and provides one undo step. Sound deletion requires exactly one SoundDefault effect and one fixed volume attribute; its four private definitions are removed while linked resources and shared identities remain. GuideImage deletion requires the evidenced VisualDefault and GuideImageDefault layout with eleven attributes, including distinct list and named image-number attributes; fifteen private definitions are removed, preserving the linked guide-directory resource. Sound and Guide creation and playback, and Sound key/volume editing remain unsupported. Cubism vendor acceptance is not run.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > scene > Image row > Delete image track > Confirm track deletion
CAN3 Outline > scene > track > Delete track > Confirm track deletion

commands.description: Duplicate an existing CAN3 Image, supported Guide or supported Sound track in its own scene and parent group. Requires sceneGuid, trackGuid, name and matching expectedRevision; returns a snapshot plus trackGuid. Copies owned attributes, keys and caches without changing the linked resource. Guide copies preserve distinct image-number attributes and never open the directory. Sound copies require one SoundDefault effect with fixed volume, clone four private definitions and preserve timing, speed, default volume and volume caches without opening audio paths. Provides undo, redo and native save. Refuses unsupported effects, shared mutable storage and unknown references. Does not create blank tracks or replace resources. No Cubism Editor acceptance is claimed.

Insert a control point at index (0 to the number of points) into every keyform of one ArtPath of the active CMO3 (stroke editing). The new point starts as a copy of the point it goes before (the last point when appended), and the values given here replace that copy's in every form: position, startVelocity and endVelocity as [x,y], width (0 or more), opacity (0..1), color ([r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] in 0..1) and corner. Every value is optional. No midpoint is computed. An ArtPath whose forms hold different numbers of points is refused. ArtPaths are read and edited, not drawn. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Delete control point index from every keyform of one ArtPath of the active CMO3. The last point of an ArtPath stays, a point the file names from elsewhere is refused, and so is an ArtPath whose forms hold different numbers of points. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Edit the stored values of control point index of one ArtPath form in the active CMO3 (stroke editing): position, startVelocity and endVelocity as [x,y], width (0 or more), opacity (0..1), color ([r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] in 0..1) and corner. Every key is optional. ArtPaths are read and edited, not drawn. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.
Read supplied-profile CMO3/CAN3 authoring container and model definitions without changing the active session; does not evaluate or render a Cubism model.

Compute in-range mathematical weights on primary LINEAR keyform grids without changing the session. Parameter IDs omitted from parameterValues use active runtime values, or model defaults for path queries; sourceGuid optionally selects one owner. Does not clamp, wrap, evaluate morphs or extended caches, transform coordinates, or produce a Cubism pose.

Add morph geometry, raw Glue intensity, and opacity deltas to primary LINEAR forms in their recorded coordinate spaces without changing the session. Requires an exact normal default corner and non-repeating MORPH_TARGET parameters whose range includes neutral zero. Active SNS_CURVE settings consume validated stored intermediate morph keys; extendedMorphExtensions identifies selected extensions. Inactive caches are preserved; curve regeneration and normal extended caches remain unsupported. Unique full-range constraint curves interpolate linearly and use the smallest controller limit; opacity clamps after all deltas. Supports positions, raw Glue intensity, and raw rotation angle/origin; changed draw order/colors/scale/reflection, ambiguous or partial constraint graphs and ambiguous bases are rejected. Uses active runtime values, or model defaults for path queries, unless parameterValues overrides IDs; sourceGuid optionally selects one owner. Deformer transforms are not evaluated; this is not a Cubism pose.

clampToKeys.description: On a keyform axis of a non-repeating parameter, hold the end keyform when a value lies outside the keyed span, take a value closer than 0.001 to a key as that key (Cubism Core 6.0.1 snaps this way), and report the resulting axisValues; morph-target keys and repeating parameters are not snapped; the default rejects samples outside the span and does not snap.

commands.description: Interpolate primary LINEAR keyform geometry and numeric attributes in their recorded coordinate spaces without changing the session. Uses active runtime values, or model defaults for path queries, unless parameterValues overrides IDs; sourceGuid optionally selects one owner. Preserves separate coordinate representations and raw rotation angles and floating draw order. Does not evaluate morphs, extended caches, deformer transforms, runtime sorting or a Cubism pose.

Read CMO3 source geometry, primary and generated forms, multi-axis grids, morph targets, blend-weight constraints, and texture metadata without changing the session. An ArtPath source lists its stroke settings and the control points of each keyform; it is not evaluated or drawn; its name, ID, parent, clipping masks and control points can be edited, and points added and deleted. The model's brushes list the stored ArtPath brush identifiers, drawing settings and textureInput metadata, including the current input's stored canvas transform. live2d_brush_set edits stored drawing settings and transform coefficients; live2d_brush_replace_image replaces an existing shared image with a same-size static PNG. Generated vertex-count and target-availability flags describe incomplete caches. Non-null morph edit base maps are not decoded. Positions retain source coordinate spaces; this is not an evaluated canvas pose.
guiEntry: CAN3 Outline > New CAN3 curve > PartOpacity > Refresh Part choices

commands.description: Replace the existing shared image of an ArtPath brush of the active CMO3 with a static PNG file at path. The PNG dimensions must match the existing image and resource metadata. Every brush and mesh referencing that image entry changes; the reply reports affectedBrushes and affectedTextures. Image bytes are preserved without premultiplication. Identical bytes are a no-op; otherwise one undo step. No resizing, image selection or new image entries. Requires expectedRevision.

Edit the stored drawing settings of one ArtPath brush of the active CMO3 (guid from the brushes of live2d_authoring_read): drawingCurveType (SPRITE or TIP_USE, the types the supplied files store), widthCoefficient, and the numbers of textureUvData (up, upInter, center, downInter, down, inStart, repeatStart, repeatEnd, outEnd), fixWidthData (upFixedWidth, downFixedWidth) and spriteData (density, useTextureMagnification), plus the six stored affine coefficients under textureInput.currentTextureInputData.optionalTransformOnCanvas. Use live2d_brush_replace_image for image bytes. A group names only the numbers it changes. Each change rewrites its one stored token; a setting the file does not store for the brush is refused. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Return the display information of the active CMO3 document in the .cdi3.json layout: IDs, names and groups of parameters, parameter groups, Parts, and the parameter pairs shown as one two-axis control. With path, also create that JSON atomically at an unused destination. History is unchanged.

Convert the active CMO3 document to an INX model: the default pose becomes the node tree with the CMO3 textures, and every parameter becomes a one-axis INX parameter whose keys hold the vertex offsets of the pose at that key, so each single-parameter key looks the same. Lossy: warp and rotation deformers, Glue and blend shapes are baked into those offsets, combined poses add in INX, and physics, blend-shape constraints and CAN3 animations are not converted unless animation names a CAN3 file; the answer lists these counts under baked and notConverted. Keyed ArtMesh and offscreen-Part draw order and opacity become zSort and opacity bindings of the same parameter (a node whose opacity is keyed by several parameters multiplies them). With animation, every scene of that CAN3 that drives the model (resourceGuid picks the model resource when the CAN3 has several) becomes an INX animation of frame-exact Linear keyframes sampled by the CAN3 player, with Bezier handles baked. Each Part with opacity curves becomes a 0..1 "<Part> opacity" parameter whose opacity bindings reach the nodes the Part fades, driven by one lane per scene; a Part that fades no drawn node is counted as not converted, and so is a Part when a node it fades already has an opacity binding and is drawn at opacity 0 at the default pose. Between keys the INX draw order interpolates linearly where the CMO3 rounds to whole draw orders, so ties between meshes can resolve differently mid-key. With path, also create the INX atomically at an unused destination. History is unchanged.

Delete one source of the active CMO3 (ArtMesh, deformer, empty Part, Glue or ArtPath, by guid) that no other source names as parent, deformer, clipping mask or Glue target; its texture goes too when no other ArtMesh uses it, and so do the objects only it uses (its GUID object, extensions, keyform grid) and a Cubism 2.1 conversion record that names it. The root Part, a Part with children and a source the file names from anywhere else are refused, and the message says where. An unused ArtPath brush can also be deleted; any remaining source or XML reference refuses deletion. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Copy one ArtMesh, ArtPath, deformer, Glue or empty Part of the active CMO3 (by guid) under the same parent, after the last source of its kind, or one parameter that no source keys and the physics settings do not use, at the end and in its group. The copy is the original's own XML with new identifiers. An ArtPath brush can also be copied at the end of the brush list, with its current settings and texture metadata but without duplicating image bytes. A texture setting embedded in another model object is refused. It keeps the name and takes id (default <id>_copy). A source the file names from outside the sources, for example from a registry, is refused. The reply carries the copy's guid. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.
Apply an imported expression once after the active native motion/timeline preview. With fades true it fades in over its FadeInTime as motion, timeline or physics playback advances.
Import a bounded Live2D Expression JSON file into session-only native playback state.
List imported session-only expressions and the active expression.
Clear the active session-only expression.

Paste Form / Blend Form on one ArtMesh or Warp source of the active CMO3: form formGuid becomes itself + ratio × (fromFormGuid − itself), vertex by vertex, and so does an ArtMesh form's opacity. ratio defaults to 1 (a plain paste). invert vertical|horizontal mirrors the copied shape about that line through the centre of its bounds first, and properties [vertices, opacity] limits what is pasted (Paste Form Special; default both). Both forms are primary forms of the source in coordinateType. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Edit the stored settings of one primary form in the active CMO3: drawOrder (integer 0..1000) of an ArtMesh or ArtPath form, multiplyColor or screenColor ([r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] in 0..1) of an ArtMesh or Part form, angle, origin [x,y], scale and reflectX/reflectY of a rotation deformer form, intensity (0..1) of a Glue form. ArtPath drawOrder requires one existing private literal integer through private inline form inheritance; missing, aliased, shared, shadowed or nonliteral storage is refused. It changes stored order, not ArtPath rendering. Every key is optional; other fields the file does not store are copied from the same field elsewhere in the file, and refused when the file stores it nowhere. coordinateType is omitted for Part and Glue forms. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Multiple key editing of ArtMesh or existing private primary ArtPath opacity in the active CMO3: every form in forms [{sourceGuid, formGuid, coordinateType}] gets opacity (method overwrite, the default) or its own opacity plus opacity clamped to 0..1 (method add). Repeated forms apply sequentially. Every form must pass the single-opacity setter and storage checks; any refusal leaves the entire edit unchanged. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision. Stored editing does not establish ArtPath rendering or vendor acceptance.

Edit the explicit opacity scalar of one primary ArtMesh or ArtPath form in the active CMO3 document, with shared revision and undo/redo. Requires the current expectedRevision and exact owner/form/coordinate identity. Values must fit the native finite float field; authored values are preserved without clamping. ArtPath requires one existing private literal float through private inline form inheritance; missing, aliased, shared, shadowed or nonliteral storage is refused. Unsupported derived forms are rejected. Stored editing does not establish ArtPath rendering or vendor acceptance.

Edit one primary ArtMesh or Warp form vertex in its recorded coordinate space in the active CMO3 document, with shared revision and undo/redo. Requires the current expectedRevision and exact owner/form/coordinate identity. Unsupported shared storage or derived caches are rejected; this does not evaluate a canvas pose.

Add a key to one ArtMesh or warp deformer of the active CMO3 (sourceGuid) on its axis for one parameter (parameterGuid). key lies in the parameter's range and is not a key yet. Each new form takes the vertices and opacity interpolated linearly between its neighbours on the axis (or those of the end form) and is written as a copy of a form the file stores. Sources with blend shapes or extended interpolation forms are refused. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Delete one key, and the forms on it, from the axis of one ArtMesh or warp deformer of the active CMO3 (sourceGuid) for one parameter (parameterGuid). The last key of an axis stays. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Attach an explicit CMO3, or a runtime `.model3.json` (its `.moc3` and textures read from its folder; a bare `.moc3` is refused), to the active CAN3 for bounded native parameter and GUID-bound PartOpacity playback. A runtime model takes the parameter and Part GUIDs of the CAN3's curves; Glue, blend shapes, keyform colours (versions 5 and 6) and offscreen Parts (version 6) are read; `warnings` lists blend shapes the file leaves without a default keyform or parameter. Parameter GUID/attribute IDs and Part GUIDs are validated against the selected model resource; underscore PartOpacity channels retain their exact map keys. Linked paths are never followed automatically.

Delete one parameter of the active CMO3 (by guid) that no source keys and the physics settings do not use, with its places in parameter groups and the objects only it uses. A parameter the file names from anywhere else is refused, and the message says where. Motions that use its ID are not changed. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Change the stored minimum, maximum, default and repeat flag of one parameter of the active CMO3 (by guid); each key is optional. The default must lie in the range, and so must every key a source has on the parameter. A field the file does not store is copied from another parameter. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Set one runtime parameter of the active Live2D document within its authored range. A value outside the range is refused, or wraps into it when the parameter repeats. Changes subsequent active authoring queries, without changing saved authoring data, revision or undo/redo. This does not render a Cubism pose.

Apply one typed edit to the physics settings stored in the active CMO3 document, with shared revision and undo/redo. Requires the current expectedRevision. Address a group by its document-order index from live2d_physics3_read. Set a group field with field=name or normalization.position.min|default|max (or .angle.*) plus value; set the physics rate with field=fps and no group (value null clears it); edit one list item with group, list=inputs|outputs|vertices, index, field and value (fields: source/destination parameter ID, type X|Angle on inputs, weight 0-100, reflect, scale, vertexIndex, x, y, mobility 0-1, delay, acceleration, radius); remove with group+remove or group+list+index+remove; insert with group+list+insert+value (object of item fields; vertices need x,y,mobility,delay,acceleration,radius, inputs need source+type, outputs need destination+vertexIndex; inserting a vertex at index 0 of a nonempty strand is rejected, the strand root stays fixed). group+duplicate=true appends a copy with new GUIDs and the next PhysicsSetting<n> ID. To create the first group in an existing empty inline settings list, omit group/list/index/field and use insert:0 plus value:{name,normalization:{position:{min,default,max},angle:{min,default,max}},inputs:[],outputs:[],vertices:[]}; supply all fields and use the same item shapes for populated arrays. Missing/null/shared sets and nonempty lists refuse donor-free creation. Inserted items use the known inline layout, and parameter fields use the file's own form (a reference to its shared GUID object when it keeps one). Editing aliased or shared storage is rejected; a failed edit changes nothing. With group, list=inputs|vertices and preset (the name of a preset kept by live2d_physics3_preset_save) the list of that group is made the preset: matching items are set field by field, missing items are inserted at the end and surplus items are removed from the end, in one undo step; no other field is allowed with preset, and a step the edit would refuse (an unknown parameter, shared storage, an output that names a removed vertex) refuses the whole call.

Return the physics settings of the active CMO3 document in the .physics3.json layout: inputs, outputs, pendulum vertices and normalization of each setting, numbered PhysicsSetting1..N in document order, with numbers rounded to three decimals. With path, also create that JSON atomically at an unused destination. History is unchanged.
Delete a preset that live2d_physics3_preset_save kept, of the kind list names (inputs or vertices). A name that is not saved is refused.

List the presets live2d_physics3_preset_save kept, as {inputs: {name: {items}}, vertices: {name: {items}}}. The resource resource://soul2d/physics3/presets returns the same. The three preset tools answer with any document open; only a save with group needs the active CMO3.

Keep the inputs of a physics group, or its physical model (the pendulum vertices), under name, for live2d_physics3_edit to use as preset. list is inputs or vertices. Give group, the index from live2d_physics3_read, to keep the list that group holds now (the active CMO3 document is read, nothing else changes), or items, which work with any document open: for inputs [{source: parameter ID, type X|Angle, weight 0-100, reflect, scale?}], for vertices [{x, y, mobility 0-1, delay, acceleration, radius}] with at least two vertices and a radius of 0 only on the first. An input keeps the parameter by its ID, not its GUID, and an output is no part of either kind. The presets belong to the user of this machine, not to the document: they are the files physics3-input-presets.json and physics3-model-presets.json in the settings directory, and the call changes no document and adds no undo step. A saved name is replaced only with overwrite:true, and the answer then holds replaced:true. Refused: group and items together or neither, a key a preset cannot keep, a name that is not 1 to 64 characters, has a control character anywhere or white space at either end, a 65th preset of a kind, presets that would make a file larger than 1 MiB, and a host without a settings directory. There are no built-in presets.

Return the typed full-precision view of the physics settings stored in the active CMO3 document: per-group name, normalization ranges, inputs, outputs and pendulum vertices in document order, with a shared/editable flag on each. Groups have no stable ID; indexes are positions under the current revision. History is unchanged.
Attach an explicit Physics3 file to the native model. Runtime only; linked files are not followed.
Set the complete native Physics3 gravity and wind vectors for this session.
Reset native Physics3 runtime values without editing the document.
Stabilize the native Physics3 runtime pose without editing the document.
Advance native Physics3 by seconds without editing the document.
Attach an explicit Pose3 file to the native model. Runtime only; linked files are not followed.
Reset native Pose groups and selection signals without editing the document.
Advance native Pose by seconds, optionally overriding known selection signals.

Set the display name of one ArtMesh, ArtPath, Part, deformer or Glue (its localName), of one parameter or of one ArtPath brush in the active CMO3 document, with shared revision and undo/redo. guid is the source, parameter or brush GUID from live2d_authoring_read; the ID string is not changed. Requires the current expectedRevision. A name stored as a shared string, or an object without a name field, is rejected.

Move one source of the active CMO3 (ArtMesh, deformer, Part, Glue or ArtPath, by guid) under another Part (parent, a Part GUID), at the end of its children. Its deformer and vertices do not change. The root Part, a move under itself or its own descendant, and a file whose GUID entries are shared definitions are refused. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Reattach one static ArtMesh of the active CMO3 to an existing static Rotation chain while preserving canvas coordinates within 1e-6 per coordinate. Source-local round-trip precision loss above 1e-6 is refused. Requires sourceGuid, targetDeformerGuid and the current expectedRevision. Changes only its target and sole DeformerLocal form positions; Part membership, opacity, topology, UVs and material stay unchanged. Root rotations must use Canvas forms, nested rotations DeformerLocal, with neutral opacity and positive individual and complete-chain scale at least 1e-6. Keyed, morph, extended, reflected, Warp, Glue-bound, aliased or numerically unsafe geometry is refused. Root/detach destinations are unsupported. One undo step; the same target is a no-op after revision and identity checks. Read back with live2d_authoring_read or the model in resource://vsoul/snapshot. This bounded source edit does not establish vendor parity.

Read a Live2D runtime model without changing the session: a .model3.json (its file references, groups and hit areas, and the .moc3 it names, which must stay inside its folder) or a .moc3 alone. Answers version, canvas {pixelsPerUnit, origin, size}, parts (IDs), deformers {ids, warp, rotation}, parameters [{id, min, max, default}], drawables [{id, parentPart, texture, vertices, triangles}] and, for a .model3.json, model3. Soul2D's own clean-room reader built from the structure of sample files (ADR 0004): it reads .moc3 versions 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 in the little-endian layout and refuses anything else rather than guess. Keyforms and deformer geometry are not read.

Change the ID string of one ArtMesh, Part, deformer, Glue or ArtPath, of one parameter or of one ArtPath brush, in the active CMO3 (by guid). id is 1 to 63 ASCII letters, digits or underscores and unused among the sources (or the parameters, or the brushes). A parameter's keyform axes and morph weights follow; motions, expressions and physics files that name the old ID are not changed. One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Edit the stored settings of one source in the active CMO3: an ArtMesh or Part's blend mode as colorComposition (NORMAL, ADD, ADD_R2, ADD_GLOW, DARKEN, MULTIPLY_R2, COLOR_BURN, LINEAR_BURN, LIGHTEN, SCREEN, COLOR_DODGE, OVERLAY, SOFTLIGHT, HARDLIGHT, LINEAR_LIGHT, HSL_HUE, HSL_COLOR) and alphaComposition (OVER, ATOP, OUT, CONJOINT, DISJOINT). invertClippingMask applies to ArtMesh, Part and ArtPath; an ArtPath requires one existing private plain boolean in its inline source inheritance, without shared, referenced or shadowed storage. useOffscreen applies to a Part. clipGuids lists the clipping mask ArtMeshes of an ArtMesh, Part or ArtPath (kept masks keep their order, new ones go last). closed and divisionCount edit an ArtPath's existing private direct boolean and unsigned 32-bit integer. brushGuid selects exactly one existing listed brush, changing only the ArtPath's private GUID slot. Missing, shared or ambiguous storage is refused. These are stored settings; ArtPath rendering and vendor acceptance are separate. Other scalar fields the file does not store are copied from the same field elsewhere in the file (refused when there is none); a mask list the source does not store is copied, emptied, from another source of the same kind (refused when none stores one). One undo step; needs the current expectedRevision.

Set the user data text of one ArtMesh in the active CMO3 document, with shared revision and undo/redo; an empty value clears it. guid is the ArtMesh GUID from live2d_authoring_read, whose sources[].userData shows the text. Requires the current expectedRevision. At most 65536 bytes; tab and line feed are the only control characters allowed. An ArtMesh whose file has no inline userData field is rejected.

Return the ArtMesh user data of the active CMO3 document in the .userdata3.json layout: one row {Target: ArtMesh, Id, Value} per ArtMesh with user data, in document order, and Meta with UserDataCount and TotalUserDataSize (UTF-8 bytes). With path, also create that JSON atomically at an unused destination. History is unchanged.
Add one Part per PNG/TGA file under parent (default root) in one undo step.
Merge another INP/INX file's nodes, parameters and animations into the open project in one undo step.

Merge Krita layers into the open INX document (models and textures) as one undo step. choices override the plan defaults per layer index. Result {created, replaced, textures, missingLayers (always empty: a document links to a PSD only), removed}.

Match the layers of a Krita file to the Parts of the open INX document without changing it. The plan has skippedLayers when layers were not imported and blendModesNotApplied when a blend mode is not one the engine has.

Merge PSD layers into the open INX document (models and textures) as one undo step. choices override the plan defaults per layer index. Without path it relinks to the PSD the document is linked to (meta.psdSource; the absolute path is stored in the file). A document without a link is linked to the PSD read; link true relinks a linked one to path, link false never links. removed says what happens to Parts whose linked layer the file no longer has and no choice fills: keep (default), hide (enabled false) or remove (deleted like node_delete; a Part with children is hidden instead). Only a merge of the linked PSD (or of a first PSD into an unlinked document) finds such Parts. Result {created, replaced, textures, missingLayers, removed}.

Match the layers of a PSD file to the Parts of the open INX document without changing it. Without path it reads the PSD the document is linked to (meta.psdSource, set by import_psd and merge_psd_apply). The plan has source (the path read), missingLayers [{part, path}] (Parts linked to a layer the file no longer has, by path or by name; empty unless path is the linked PSD or the document is unlinked) and blendModesNotApplied when a layer's blend mode is not one the engine has.

Copy one Part's rest triangles into the session mesh clipboard without changing the document. A later edit of the source does not change the clipboard. X or Y rotation, a nonlinear deformer ancestor, pinToMesh, or dynamic deformation is refused.

Vertex-definition edits of a Part mesh (the mesh editor's Point, Connect, Edge cutter and Grid tools) as one undo step. Edits run in order: add {pos, connect?}, remove {indices | at}, move {indices, delta}, connect/disconnect/toggle {a, b}, cut {from, to}, grid_create {bounds, cuts?}, grid_axes {ys, xs}, grid_add_axis {pos}, grid_remove_axis {vertex}, grid_move {vertex, to}, triangulate (merges coincident vertices first), flip {axis}, path_deform {path, target, indices?, resolution?}, reset (the quad a default import gives the Part's texture, half sizes rounded down, as Cubism Reset mesh), merge {distance?} (vertices at most distance apart, 0 by default, become the lowest-numbered one). Triangles are rebuilt from the vertex connections, wound counter-clockwise, and UVs are position / texture size + 0.5. Deform bindings are carried over to the new vertices; welds, depth data and skinning weights are rejected when vertices change.

Prototype (issue #244): import the meshes of a glTF 2.0 or VRM file (.gltf, .glb, .vrm) as Parts seen from the front. Each triangle primitive with a base colour texture becomes one Part below the document root, placed where the DepthRigRoot `root` puts its bones: x and y are kept, z becomes the depth of each vertex, triangles that turn away from the viewer are not drawn and the others are drawn far to near. A skinned mesh is bound to the standard bones below `root` with the skin weights of each vertex; the weight on a bone that is no standard bone goes to the standard bone above it. rig_import_gltf must have added the bones from the same file with the same unitsPerSourceUnit, and the call is refused when they are not where the file puts them, or when `root` is moved or turned out of the picture plane. Only buffers and PNG images inside the file are read (the GLB chunk or data URIs). Morph targets, normals and further attribute sets are listed in the returned loss report as dropped and shading as approximated, so the call needs lossy=true. unitsPerSourceUnit is the number of canvas units for one metre of the file and is required. When the file states rights, the document must already keep them (rig_import_gltf does) and the call needs acknowledgeRights=true, which only the user may decide. INX documents only. While `needs` names an argument, with dryRun=true, or when the file has no primitive to import, the report is returned and nothing is written (`applied` false). The last applied report is readable at resource://soul2d/mesh/import-report. One undo step.
Reflect Path, Grid, or Part vertices with the mesh-editor mirror. A Part needs vertices or mesh.verts. A grid mirror requires every vertex and does not call rig.mirror.

Append the mesh clipboard onto Part id in that Part's rest space and consume the clipboard. reflect is none, horizontal, vertical, or both, across the target mesh origin. A failed paste keeps the clipboard. One undo step. The target's texture, transform, name, and UUID stay. Welds, depth data, and skinning weights are refused when the vertex count changes.

Rectangle (rect [x0, y0, x1, y1]) or lasso (clicked points) selection over a Part's vertices, or over rest + keypoint offsets when parameter and key are given. mode is replace, add, remove or toggle against current. Read only.

Count the tree that is rendered without changing the session: nodes, maskReferences and maxOffscreenDepth, the deepest nesting of offscreen passes (Composite and DynamicComposite nodes; CMO3 Parts with offscreen drawing). 0 means none; a tree deeper than offscreenDepthLimit does not render. A hidden node is counted, as it is for that limit.

Apply a model template that model_template_export wrote to the document, in one undo step. Template Parts map to the document's Parts (or to the Parts listed in parts) by name, or with match=position to the nearest centre once the template is fitted. The fit is one uniform scale from the areas of the two sets of Parts plus a move that puts centre on centre; scale and offset override it. The template's Nodes, GridDeformers, PathDeformers and Composites are copied, fitted, with new UUIDs; each mapped Part moves under the copy of its template parent and stays where it is drawn. Parameters with a binding on a copied node or a mapped Part come along: with parameters=join (the default) a document parameter of the same name and axes takes the bindings, otherwise a parameter is added (named "<name> (Template)" when the name is taken). Deform and translation keys scale with the fit; a Part's deform keys are re-sampled at the document Part's own vertices. The template's parameter groups are not kept (a document parameter inside a group can still be joined) and physics is not copied. Answers scale, offset, created node UUIDs, mapped and unmapped Parts, the parameters and skippedBindings (bindings on nodes that were neither copied nor mapped, such as parameter links).
Write the document's node tree, without textures, and its parameters to a model template .json file (format soul2d.model-template.v1) without changing the session. name defaults to the file name.
Advance the active Motion3 preview by seconds, optionally looping at its effective clip end. Default clamps at the end; fades as the seek set them, no blending.
Persist explicit Motion3 Parameter ID to INX UUID/axis bindings in one undo. Empty bindings clear the mapping; raw motion data stays unchanged.

preserve_unknown.description: Keep existing unknown fields for matching IDs; edit only id/parameter/axis. Defaults to false.

commands.description: Read persisted Motion3 parameter bindings.

Atomically create edited Motion3 JSON at an unused destination, without changing history. With runtimeModel (a .model3.json or .moc3), the export is refused unless every Parameter and PartOpacity curve names an ID that runtime model has; the reply then carries checkedCurves.

Set the fade-in and fade-out seconds of a Motion3 motion (Meta) or, with curve, of one curve, which then overrides the motion's. A number sets the time, null removes it, an absent key stays. An INX motion is edited in one undo; a motion on a CMO3 lives in this session. Playback uses them only when motion3_seek has fades.
Import Motion3 into INX history or the active CMO3 session-only clip library. CMO3 clips are lost on open/new and must be exported separately; this does not load or render a Live2D model.
List imported Motion3 data without changing runtime playback.
Edit a zero-based curve/point in one undo. Time edits normalize restricted Bezier handle times to preserve other curves, and extend Duration when needed. Times are seconds.

Read Motion3 runtime parameter values at seconds without applying them. INX uses explicit bindings; CMO3 matches exact native Parameter IDs and returns scalar values. Out-of-range values fail, except the X value of a repeating INX parameter, which evaluation wraps; every unmapped curve is reported. No fades, blending or Cubism pose evaluation.

Key a pose switch in a Motion3 motion on the active CMO3: at time (seconds), the PartOpacity curve of part is keyed 1 and those of the other parts in its group of the attached Pose3 are keyed 0. A key within half a frame of an anchor sets it, any other key is joined by stepped segments, and a key touching a segment that is not stepped is refused for the whole group. A missing curve holds its key from 0, so key the starting part at 0 first. The motion lives in this session like the import (a playing preview shows the edit at the next seek or advance); read it with motion3_read and export it with motion3_export.

Evaluate raw Motion3 curves at seconds, without loop, fades, runtime blending or pose changes.

Apply Motion3 runtime values. CMO3 matches native Parameter IDs and attached Pose selection signals, replaying Pose at 60 Hz for deterministic seeks up to one hour. Leaves document/history unchanged and reports unmapped curves. No blending between motions. With fades true, playback starts here: each Parameter curve is weighted by its fade (the curve's, else the motion's; Cubism's sine ease) from the value without the motion, fading in over the time played since this seek and out towards the clip end unless motion3_advance loops. Without it the curves apply in full.

A type or a name that starts with =, +, -, @, a tab, a carriage return or an apostrophe is written after an apostrophe, so that a spreadsheet does not take it for a formula. The format is Soul2D's own and was not checked against a CSV that Cubism Editor writes. The same text is the resource resource://soul2d/object/names-csv.

A row names its object by uuid and gives it the name of the row; one leading apostrophe of a type or a name is taken off, and an object without a row keeps its name. The whole call is refused when a uuid names nothing or has two rows, when the type of a row is not the type of its object, or when a name would be empty, taken or longer than 4096 characters. Every name is judged against the finished document, so two rows may swap names. Only names are read: no object is created and no value is changed. With dryRun=true, or when no name differs, nothing is written (`applied` false).

The presets belong to the user of this machine, not to the document: they are a file in the settings directory, and the call changes no document and adds no undo step. A saved name is replaced only with overwrite:true, and the answer then holds replaced:true. Refused: a call without a setting, a setting physics_set refuses, nodes, output_scale_x, output_scale_y and preset, which a preset cannot keep, a name that is not 1 to 64 characters, has a control character anywhere or white space at either end, a 65th preset, presets that would make the file larger than 1 MiB, and a host without a settings directory.
